documentQualityDecisions.rationale: The preview-version description exactly matches the literal and preview marker.
Available API versions remains accurate after adding the July preview.
The historical write-result description remains consistent with its CCF transaction-ID header and version removal.
Write transaction state clearly explains the required TransactionState field.
HTTP status code accurately describes the @statusCode 503 literal without requiring repetition of the value.
Response body adequately describes the @bodyRoot LedgerWriteResult property.
The description explains the rollback error represented by this 503 error response.
Application claims list accurately describes the optional ApplicationClaim array.
The new write-result summary fits collectionId, state, optional receipt and claims, and no longer promises a header inside this body model.
Returned ledger-write result accurately describes the transaction-ID header and body wrapper.
The description explains the ReceiptContents field's purpose without asserting it is always present.
The description accurately states collectionId is optional on the historical write operation; the same narrow description exists on the baseline operation.
Collection ID clearly identifies the optional query parameter.
Ledger entry adequately describes the LedgerEntry request body.
Comma-separated tags clearly explains how this string query value is represented.
The unchanged statement about optional collectionId remains true; omission of the new wait option is not a contradictory or newly stale claim.
The description explains the boolean wait option and conditional receipt consistently with the false default and optional receipt field.
